It featured revolutionary pre-rendered 3D graphics that give the game a very unique look compared to most other games on consoles at the time. The two playable characters featured in the game are the titular character, Donkey Kong and his nephew, Diddy Kong. Together the two swing, climb, jump, swim, cartwheel, ride animals, and blast out of barrels on their way to recover their stolen bannanas from the evil K

fields.title: Resonite
fields.description: Enter a novel digital universe with infinite possibilities. Whether you resonate with people around the world in a casual conversation, playing games and socializing or you riff off each other when creating anything from art to programming complex games, you'll find your place here.

fields.title: Sniper Hunter Shooter
fields.description: For game lovers seeking realism, Sniper Hunter Shooter is an experience not to be missed! Fight as a sniper in a post-apocalyptic world, create your strategy, and test your shooting skills.

fields.title: Apocalypse
fields.description: Apocalypse is a multi-user dungeon (MUD) built on a codebase called DIKU. The code has been modified over the course of about twenty-six years to come into its current state. Apocalypse draws heavily upon the world of Athas and the lore of Dark Sun.

fields.title: Suzumiya Haruhi no Tsuisou
fields.description: Suzumiya Haruhi no Tsuisou is a “wandering adventure” game for the PlayStation 3 and PlayStation Portable, published by Namco Bandai Games. It was released as a tie-in to The Disappearance of Haruhi Suzumiya film, taking place shortly afterward in the parallel universe.

Picture Builder is a delight for enthusiasts of pixel art, color by number, puzzles, object finding, hidden objects, and other logical games and brain teasers. Within Picture Builder, you'll discover various cityscapes initially devoid of life. It's up to you to assemble all the elements of the picture, with each object or character representing a distinct puzzle piece. Since all puzzles are entirely unique, playing Picture Builder is always a joyful and intriguing game experience.

fields.title: Your Cattle
fields.description: An interactive casual game. By utilizing mechanics such as charging, knocking back, stunning, and blink, players can hone their skills in a low-pressure environment.Accompanied by exquisite music and smooth interactions, relieve emotional stress.

fields.title: Evil Genius
fields.description: Evil Genius focuses on building an island lair and the management of minions that are employed by the Evil Genius, allowing the player to progress through the main storyline with achieving world domination as the end goal of the game. Although not explicitly stated the use of historic regions the Eastern Block and events such as the Cuban Missile Crisis within the game suggest that it is set in the 1960s and 70s and that the game is progressing through an alternate timeline.

fields.title: Parked in the Dark
fields.description: Find you car somewhere in the garage by finding clues, before the time runs out. But you are not as alone as you think...

fields.title: Miner Tower Defense
fields.description: This is a game that combines mining and tower defense elements. Players need to build defense towers by digging and gathering minerals underground to resist a constant stream of monsters!

fields.title: 1001 Jigsaw: World Tour - London
fields.description: Assemble jigsaws from a multitude of pieces and learn the history, traditions and attractions of London in 500 high-quality photos.

fields.title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 3 - Collector's Edition
fields.description: Visit 9 European countries and search for interesting items in unforgettable old European towns and play a bunch of new mini games.

A story about unraveling and cutting tangled threads.

Aporia, a store staffed by talented but somewhat out-of-the-ordinary employees, has two faces.
After operating as an ordinary cafe, only a limited number of customers are offered a relaxing time and special services.

fields.title: Ringlorn Saga
fields.description: Ringlorn Saga is an adventure RPG inspired by the Japanese PC classics. Prince Gerhard the Brave embarks on a journey to the neighboring land to investigate the appearance of a magic barrier and his father's disappearance.

fields.title: Refactor
fields.description:
In 2015 I released an album, entitled Refactor. Several of the tracks started out as OSTs for aborted game projects, and most of the others were inspired by my love of video game music in general. I wanted to make some music videos for the songs to pay homage to the games that inspired them

In 2017 I quit my job to go indie, and figured that I should make a bunch of small, simple games while I figured out what I wanted to be doing long-term.

fields.title: Mystery Riddles
fields.description: With the Great Tapestries fraying and darkness returning to threaten Mysteria it's up to you, the last Pictomancer, to quest throughout the kingdom and restore these powerful images and save the kingdom. Take on the journey in one of two modes, tackling either the always-popular Pic-A-Pix puzzles or the brand new Fill-A-Pix!

fields.title: Twilight Wars
fields.description: Twilight Wars is a dungeon crawler set in a cyberpunk world where secret agents battle for corporate interests. Bring back a secret organization, recruit and equip a team of specialists - and eliminate those who stand in your way!

fields.title: Zen Chess: Mate in Three
fields.description: Zen Chess: Mate in Three is a minimalist chess puzzle game. Solve mate-in-three problems in a beautifully designed chess board.

fields.title: My Club Dino
fields.description: My Club Dino is an online fun and educational dinosaur game, targeted for young kids in between 5 and 12 years old. My Club Dino combines fun, education and interaction

fields.title: Diamond Hollow
fields.description: Shoot, upgrade, conquer enemies, attempt achievements, collect gems, all in an attempt to escape an endless cave

fields.title: Christmas Soul
fields.description: Santa and his helpers have been kidnapped! Mysterious aliens are plotting to destroy the holidays. Fortunately, all is not lost. Take on the role of a brave Snowman – the last defender of Christmas in a dynamic 2D platformer with arcade combat. Bring back the magic of Christmas!

fields.title: Marippy
fields.description: Marippy is a Touhou fan game based on the arcade game Mappy. The game has the player play as Marisa Kirisame as she collects items from Alice Margatroid's house which Alice had stole.

fields.title: Yakuza 0: Digital Deluxe Edition
fields.description: Yakuza 0 is an action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. Serving as a prequel to the Yakuza series, it is set in 1988 Japan during the country's economic bubble era. The game follows two protagonists: Kazuma Kiryu in Tokyo's Kamurocho district and Goro Majima in Osaka's Sotenbori district. Players alternate between their stories as they navigate the criminal underworld, engaging in street fights, managing businesses, and participating in various side activiti

fields.title: Eclipse Survivors
fields.description: Experience the ultimate challenge in Eclipse Survivors, a bullet-hell / area shooter game featuring epic bosses inspired by classic 16-bit titles. Collect XP gems, master unique skills, and dodge countless enemy bullets as you face off against hordes of foes. Will you survive the eclipse?

fields.title: Gesshizu: Gajigaji Nakama wo Sodateyou
fields.description:
A game where you raise creatures hatched from eggs that can change based on how they are raised. What they eat and where they are can affect this.
You take pictures of them in various situations to complete challenges and earn rewards while filling out an encyclopedia of all the different variations available.

fields.title: No Legs? No Problem!
fields.description: Be the first to reach the goal in this intense 4 player racing game. Challenge your friends to a free for all or team up in an epic 2v2 race battle. Use your abilities to grief your enemies, or boost yourself to the finish line.

fields.title: Mary Knots: Garden Wedding
fields.description: Mary is a a truly inspired Wedding Planner. Help Mary restore and decorate the garden! Buy garden decorations to make it the perfect wedding location. Mary Knots features Hidden Object scenes, Match3 minigames and lots of decoration fun! Come, help Mary make her dreams come true!

fields.title: Mary Knots: Garden Wedding
fields.description: Mary is a a truly inspired Wedding Planner. Help Mary restore and decorate the garden! Buy garden decorations to make it the perfect wedding location. Mary Knots features Hidden Object scenes, Match3 minigames and lots of decoration fun! Come, help Mary make her dreams come true!

fields.title: Survalker
fields.description: Hordes of unknown creatures emerge from the darkness, hunting for your soul. Gather artifacts, enhance your abilities, and search for a way out of this cursed place… if an escape even exists.

fields.title: Heroes & Redemption
fields.description: Heroes & Redemption is a rogue-lite bullet-hell where you face hordes of enemies, annihilate them, learn new abilities and enhance your skills. Explore different regions, acquire new companions and embark on adventures again and again.

fields.title: Sad Virus Forest
fields.description: New part sad virus walking game series. Now collect beer bottles at forest and avoid traps.

fields.title: Flying Sword
fields.description: Flight game that uses only mouse to play (Play for 10 minutes each time). In the game you need to control the sword to fly and collect 'aura stone' as much as possible.

fields.title: Flying Sword
fields.description: Flight game that uses only mouse to play (Play for 10 minutes each time). In the game you need to control the sword to fly and collect 'aura stone' as much as possible.

fields.title: Hifuu Fragment
fields.description: 東方Projectでおなじみ、上海アリス幻樂団様制作の音楽CDシリーズ「秘封倶楽部」の二次創作ノベルゲームです。選択肢はありません。物語中で入手した記憶の欠片「フラグメント」や、プレイヤー自身の知恵によって物語を分岐させ、彼女達の冒険―蓮台野夜行―を成功に導きましょう。

fields.title: Knight Speed
fields.description: Embark on an epic medieval adventure in this fast-paced endless runner. As a valiant knight, leap across perilous towers, skillfully shoot down enemies with your trusty bow, and protect your kingdom while racing against the relentless passage of time.

fields.title: SandTest
fields.description: A Flash falling sand game by onimatrix, hosted on Kongregate.

fields.title: The Garden Pub
fields.description: You have just acquired an old pub in a small gnomish village, and now all you have to do is get it cleaned up and ready to serve the whole village! You barely have enough room to serve a handful of customers, so you must build up your reputation and gold in order to stock your pub and expand your dining area.

fields.title: PsyOps Solutions
fields.description: This JRPG was made for true JRPG fans. As an employee of PsyOps Solutions, you will need to complete the Contract given to you: Kill General Swanson. You are going to need to explore, fight, and help people out to become strong enough to complete your mission.

fields.title: Macho Shot
fields.description: Merge Machos, a fast-paced merging puzzle game, challenges players to grow their Machos by combining like types, while carefully avoiding letting them overflow off the play field. Reach for new high scores as you master the art of Macho merging. Compete against friends in multiplayer modes, with support for up to 4 players using shared Joy-Con controllers. In Score Attack, increase your score and aim for the top of global leaderboards or battle head-to-head, strategically blocking each other out

fields.title: Dog Game!
fields.description:
Dog Game is simple yet highly-addictive! To play, all you need to do is collect different kinds of cute & unique dogs and build a home for them, your very own Dog Tower! You can craft decoration and create lovely rooms to unlock cute new puppies to fill them with every single day.

Collect adorable dogs like shiba inu, husky, pug, bulldog, golden retriever and beagle! There’s over 900 puppys you can collect! Decorate rooms in your dog towers with your favourite styles: unicorn, fancy, legendary,

fields.title: WhoIs
fields.description: A 4-8 player PvP game of deception and paranoia. You have a role, a target, and one mission: eliminate them and escape. Use powerful abilities at the risk of revealing your identity. In this ever-changing arena, hunt or be hunted.

fields.title: Transformice
fields.description:
Transformice is a multiplayer game, where you are a small mouse out to get a cheese and bring the cheese back to the hole.
The game includes a physics engine, so interactions between players are realistic.
Each round lasts 2 minutes max, and in order to help the 20 or so mice-players to get the cheese, a player will be chosen to be the powerful shaman and will be able to spawn different objects to guide the mice.

fields.title: Rockman IQ Xuànfēng
fields.description:
Rockman IQ Xuànfēng (洛克人IQ旋風 "Rockman IQ Whirlwind") is a licensed Mega Man video game released for home computer only in Taiwan by Strawberry Software.
Rockman IQ Xuànfēng is a collection of five games. Players can register their names and save high scores, with a leaderboard showing the highest score from each player in each games.

fields.title: Lifetakers & Heartbreakers
fields.description: "Lifetakers & Heartbreakers" is an intense 2D side-scrolling shooter set in the war-torn world of Pavlovia.

fields.title: The Divine Speaker: The Sun and the Moon
fields.description: The story-rich 18+ prequel to The Divine Speaker. Follow alongside a younger Aemyl as he uncovers the world for himself!

fields.title: Wipeout XL
fields.description: WipEout XL is set in the year 2097, around four decades after its predecessor. Instead of the F3600 anti-gravity racing competition, the game features an even faster and more dangerous tournament: the F5000 AG league. The gameplay system is similar to that of the previous game: players race against each other or computer in high-speed futuristic environments, liberally picking up weapons scattered around the stages and using them against the opponents to finish the race in the highest position.

fields.description: Manage a Halloween store. Don't kill your co-workers. Don't sell out to corporate. Don't lose your sanity. November is just around the corner.

fields.title: 1112: Episode 02
fields.description: In 1112 Episode 02, players continue the journey with Louis Everett, who now finds himself in New York under mysterious circumstances. This sequel amplifies the intrigue as players help Louis unravel the reasons behind his unexpected arrival in the bustling city. Promising unforeseen twists and encounters, the game offers hours of engaging gameplay. fields.title: Harthorn
fields.description: It's winter break 1994 and schools out at Harthorn High School, but not all is silent in its empty classrooms and dark hallways...

fields.title: Bip and Bop
fields.description: Help, step on, or sabotage your friend! In this 2-player only puzzle platformer, perfect chemistry is the only way through. Think your friendship can handle it?

fields.title: Christmas Cat
fields.description: The Bonte cat jumps on top of the Christmas tree and sends the 20 red balls all around the house. Can you find all 20 balls by solving the puzzles?

fields.title: Kickoff Legends
fields.description: Kickoff Legends is a multi-player, cross-platform football team management game. It's a real time football multi-player game that is fast and fun. Matches are played in real time. Any platform against any platform!

fields.title: Death to Venice
fields.description:
Take part in a collective rite of putrefaction.

In a wounded world, you're dying. Venice - frail, alien, abandoned - welcomes you in your last moments.

Experience memories of death in Venice's past through six game poems across the city's sestiere districts: a death of biodiversity, a death of institutions, of community... then ponder your feelings on endings and change, talk it out with the city herself. It's all either of you has left.

Venice and its lagoon are dying. This game is for them,

fields.title: Swan Princess Gator Escape
fields.description:
Simple Frogger clone. Features zero swans.

JeanBob is back to his old tricks... "I'm on a dangerous mission! A race to death!"

You control JeanBob by tapping as he is constantly on the move in the Swan Princess's kingdom. Hopping through the forest, in the castle, the town, he goes underground and underwater... while avoiding obstacles and collecting coins along the way.

fields.title: Kingdom of Rhea
fields.description: Save the world or save life? During your adventure in Rhea, you will have to make a choice. Will you launch into the adventure and deciphering the riddles of Rhea. Would you be able to face the ancient gods?

fields.title: Bling Bling Bankruptcy
fields.description: A gambling game where you gamble to try and pay off your debts.

fields.title: Legends And Lore
fields.description: In a world of endless possibilities your tale is unwritten. For Desktop (keyboard and mouse) and VR

On the United Island of Magic, there is an Academy of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Students with magic powers, regardless of their ethnicity and background, can apply to this university. The acceptance rate is lower than Harvard. Once in, they will have the access to learn from the masters of Magic and train with other equally outstanding and magical peers.

fields.description: Cala a Boca, Galvão! is a whac-a-mole game based on the internet phenomena of the same name, where you "shut up" the Brazilian sports narrator Galvão Bueno by adding tape in his mouth.

fields.description: Axona is a grid-based puzzle game which requires 3-dimensional thinking and careful planning. Pick up the keys with the correct face of your cube and unlock the glyphs to open the gate in each level.

fields.title: 10mg: Cover Me In Leaves
fields.description:
Cover Me In Leaves is an experimental work of interactive horror fiction, about bright minds, and the end of all things. Fresh out of high school, with no prospects or aspirations, you've remained here in your small town. Everyone you knew and loved has moved on for better things. You're alone. So you get your first tattoo.

And then the trees start calling.

The once idyllic village of Greenhaven is now a near lifeless husk, the souls of its inhabitants having been drained by the powerful wizard Morg, who has used them to create the abominations that now occupy the mighty keep that was once the source of protection for the village.

fields.description:
This is the first item-seeking adventure game in the @SIMPLE DL series, in which the player solves cases that occur in the school while searching for items.
The objective of the game is to solve the case by finding the items that are given to you in various places in the school. You can enjoy both the school slapstick story and the item-seeking puzzle elements.

fields.description: Enter a dungeon where no one can tell if you are alive or dead. Embark on a moral journey steeped in love and friendship, even as you slowly lose track of what it truly means to live or what purpose even is.

fields.description:
Touya works at the residence of the Shijou family, one of the most prominent zaibatsu in the country, keeping an eye on and being of assistance to the lone daughter Ran. One day, it was decided that the free-spirited Ran will temporarily transfer to the Meigetsu Girls’ School. Since everyone at the school, from its students to the staff, are female, it would be impossible for a boy like Touya to enter on a moment’s notice.

“Well, I will be taking care of other duties while you are there then.”

Tons of treasures, 12 trophies and 5 different endings based on your performances.
Play, upgrade and play again!

fields.description: One-liners is a modern take on the classic dots and boxes game traditionally played with pen and paper. The goal is to create more complete boxes than your opponent by taking turns to draw horizontal or vertical lines between adjacent dots. fields.description: The Cherry Orchard is a 3D kinetic novel adaptation of the classic play by Anton Chekhov. Well things aren't so bad when you have a childhood friend and your cute underclassmen to help you run the cafe. Take a greatcoat, the mother-planet is calling!

Additionally, it features many elements of earlier Bond films to recreate the feel of the era such as the jet pack from Thunderball (1965) and the Aston Martin DB5 that debuted in Goldfinger (1964).

fields.title: Roopocket
fields.description: Roopocket - The adventures of Captain Frank is an atmospheric platformer with action-adventure and rpg elements. Actuate every thruster individually to perfection, and complete the space-marathon.

fields.title: Linley Henzell's Dungeon Crawl
fields.description: Linley's Dungeon Crawl (or just Dungeon Crawl or Crawl) was a roguelike computer game originally programmed by Linley Henzell in 1995, and first released to the general public on October 2, 1997. The game had a quirky license based on Bison's license and the NetHack License; Stone Soup has contacted every past contributor and relicensed to GPL-2.0-or-later.

fields.title: Whack A Hoe
fields.description: In this fun shooter game you aren't shooting bullets, NO! You're shooting Dildo's of all shapes, sizes and from the character that you choose! The object of the game is to be the leader with the highest score. Perfect your angle, wait for the power meter to get to the top (full) and WHACK AWAY.

fields.title: Skrillex Quest
fields.description: This game is a mash-up of Skrillex and Legend of Zelda, and features the Skrillex song "Summit" being the soundtrack. The game has great physics and great music to match it, all the while being a seemingly fun game.

fields.title: Mutland
fields.description: This is a new pixel style survival game. Players need to elude zombies, grow crops, harvest trees/rocks, hunt animals, gather food/drink, craft knife/axe/torch/food/medicine… Above all things, only one purpose, live!

fields.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island
fields.description: Chelshia is back in her most (only) puzzling adventure yet! In this brand-new story, Chelshia, Amelia and Bernadette arrive on the uncharted, uninhabited Hanji Isle to track down the four ancient (and expensive) tablet pieces. Take on a plethora of nonograms in Story Mode and learn the secrets of Hanji Isle or complete nonograms on a grid to build larger pictures in Mosaic Mode!

fields.title: The Battle of Polytopia
fields.description:
The Battle of Polytopia is an award-winning turn-based strategy game about building a civilization and going into battle. With millions of players, it has quickly become one of the most popular mobile strategy games.

Choose one of many tribes, explore the world, build cities, develop technologies, and wage war against other tribes to take control of the mythical land of Polytopia.

fields.title: The Sims 2: Super Collection
fields.description: In The Sims 2, your Sims will be more lifelike, more responsive, and more complex than ever before. The Sims 2: Super Collection is a Mac-exclusive edition of The Sims 2 that includes a copy of the base game The Sims 2, plus six expansion packs (University, Nightlife, Open for Business, Pets, Seasons, and Bon Voyage) and three stuff packs (Family Fun Stuff, Glamour Life Stuff, and Happy Holiday Stuff).

fields.title: Spec Ops: War on Terrorism
fields.description: In Spec Ops: War on Terrorism, the player takes control of a soldier who is fighting terrorists and must complete four unique missions. In these missions, the player is armed with three weapons; an M4A1 is the player’s primary weapon, which has 30 bullets per magazine and can be switched to by pressing the 1 key. The player’s secondary weapon is an M9 9mm pistol which holds 15 rounds per clip and can be switched to in a pinch. The third weapon in the game that the player has in their arsenal is

fields.title: The True Love Rings
fields.description: "The True Love Rings" is a scene interactive decryption game. The overall atmosphere is casual and relaxed. Players follow the prompts in the scene to gradually solve the puzzles and help solve the problems encountered in life.

fields.title: Earth Taken
fields.description: Earth Taken is set in a dystopian world devastated by an alien invasion. The environment is heavily polluted, and the government isn't helping, forcing the player to find shelter or use a gas mask to survive outdoors. The player controls a human survivor navigating through ruined landscapes, abandoned buildings, and underground bunkers.

fields.title: Frobbutt 3D
fields.description: Frobbut 3D is a 3D platformer about a goofy frog finally departing from his home to explore the land! Run, jump, flip and bounce across 5 big open levels searching every nook and cranny for valuable gems! Be creative with your movement abilities to reach the highest mountains and traverse the most dangerous paths to collect every treasure you can find.

fields.title: Amaurote
fields.description: Amaurote is a British video game for 8-bit computer systems that was released in 1987 by Mastertronic on their Mastertronic Added Dimension label. The music for the game was written by David Whittaker.

fields.title: The Arcana: A Mystic Romance
fields.description: The Arcana is a luxurious and interactive visual story and otome inspired dating sim. It also offers a variety of mystic Tarot readings from your choice of favorite characters. You can choose your own romance, story, and date your choice of characters. The mystery unfurls in 22 books (or episodes) that correspond to the 22 Major Arcana cards in Tarot.

fields.description: Sonic the Sketchhog is a 2D sidescroller platform game for mobile phones. The game features Sonic in a hand-drawn doodle style, reminiscent of Sonic 3 concept art, defeating badniks like Crabmeat as he advances his way though a drawn level.

fields.description: A remake of the popular Five Nights at Freddy's game made by Scott Cawthon, but in Unreal engine 4 with free roaming gameplay and an immersive environment.

fields.description:
Solomon's Key is a clear conceptual influence for this action puzzler. Our hero must guide a ball through a level to the spot marked 'In', by creating and removing blocks to alter its path. The game is prevented from being a pure clone due to the ball, which moves automatically once activated, and can be controlled by using strategically-placed blocks.

fields.description: Gladiator: Blades of Fury is a melee combat action fighting game set during the medieval period. Players can play as a gladiator from four different clans, namely the Barbarians, the Assassins, the Knights, and the Dwarves. All heroes are unique and have their own weapons, skills, and fighting styles.

fields.description: This is a highly flexible command RPG set in Japan's Warring States period. There are over 85 playable factions and over 300 generals! All items have random titles and qualities! Enjoy collecting generals and items, and freely forming your troops!

fields.title: Cuomo and the Quest for Gracie Mansion
fields.description: Can you beat Zohran Mamdani? You are Andrew Cuomo, disgraced former governor of New York State. Can you beat Zohran Mamdani in the New York mayoral race? Probably not. But try anyway! Six endings to discover and lots of Real Cuomo Facts to learn. Not affiliated with any political campaign or organization.

fields.title: The Kristal
fields.description: An action-adventure game that is based on the play, The Kristal of Konos.

fields.title: Dünnes Eis: Das Spiel zum Song
fields.description: Dünnes Eis is a point-and-click short story by award-winning game designer Jan “Poki” Baumann, who has won numerous awards for games such as the Deponia series. Since 2021, Poki has dedicated himself to his music and band Baumann Bergmann Pokinsson.

fields.title: Cuckoo Curling
fields.description: Curling with the rules of four in a row! A fun and surprising game of skill for everyone. Try to form a line, push your opponents, and most of all watch out for the crocodile.

fields.title: Deal With Nyarlathotep
fields.description: Naia's Contract is a survival game with elements of Texas Hold'em and mowing. You play as a gambler who has signed a soul pact with an ancient god in a Cthulhu setting. Using poker as a medium, you harness the power of the ancient god to defeat waves of enemies. Each card corresponds to a unique skill, and combining Texas Hold'em cards grants powerful powers. Ultimately, you must rely on your own wits and strength to escape from your confinement!

fields.title: Stick to the Plan
fields.description: A relaxing and charming puzzle game about Roberto, a dog who really loves loooooooong sticks with a plan in mind.

Yasmin is hosting a sleepover. As our 4 girls look through Yasmin's photo album, they remember all their craziest times together and embark on an adventure based on each of the memories in the album! fields.title: Typo II
fields.description:
Journey into the land of enhanced reality with TYPO II. This exciting educational game is by ROMOX, for your Texas Instruments 99/4A Home Computer. TYPO II is an educational and fun challenger for one player at a time. 
 
In TYPO II you can learn and improve your typing skills while enjoying the high speed action of a real arcade game on your home computer. No more long hours at the keyboard for you, with nothing to do but type. In TYPO II you control the action! Arid while you play, you learn.

fields.title: Lil Gator Game
fields.description:
The world is big when you’re a lil gator... Good thing it’s also full of friends!

There’s a buddy atop every hill in this open-world, movement-focused adventure and they all seem to need help! Bop cardboard baddies, brave serene hills and forests, and scale sheer rocks that only a kid would dare!

fields.title: SeaWorld Adventure Parks Tycoon 2
fields.description: SeaWorld Adventure Parks Tycoon 2 offers many all new features such as animal training mode, animal conservation mode, more SeaWorld attractions and animals, newly detailed maps based on the 3 SeaWorld Parks, greater guest interaction and an extended animals browser.

fields.title: Sumo Fighter
fields.description:
Appetite For Adventure
Shape up your Nintendo GAME BOY with foot-stomping action. Eat your way to super strength and pound everything in your path. Pick on everyone lighter than you as you make your way through 15 enemy-filled stages. Find the secret temples and take on the bonus stage challenges of thumb wrestling, arm wrestling or tradtional sumo fighting. Remember, don't forget to eat your rice!

fields.description:
A VR experience that will put yourself in a situation you wouldn't want to be in real life. Feel yourself inside a dangerous cave and try to walk through the only possible exit.
A short and really thrilling experience that will test your vertigo and claustrophobia. Enjoy the views while you can with the only tool you have: a spotlight.
Be brave and get into The Cave!
Specially designed also for arcade saloons, this experience will make the difference.

fields.description: Together We Play: Help Me Help You invites you and your friends to embark on a hilarious cooperative adventure! In this vibrant multiplayer game, gather up to 8 players and dive into a series of whimsical levels filled with quirky challenges, puzzles, and mini-games. Are you ready to unlock the fun?

fields.title: WWII Aces
fields.description:
Guns blazing, the Messerschmitt Bf-109 screams through the clouds toward you. Instinctively, you barrel-roll out of the way, hot lead missing your Spitfire by millimeters. You bank right, flank him and open fire. 
 
•Unleash complex acrobatic flight tricks with a simple flick of the Wii Remote ™. Roll, loop, dodge and shoot like an ace with three distinct control schemes. 
 
•Fly in over 70 historical WWII missions, including strategic bombing, paratrooper drops, frantic dogfights, and more.

fields.title: Thy Lyin' Eyes Be Damned!
fields.description:
Thy Lyin' Eyes Be Damned is a fantasy comedy otome visual novels about a pair of misfits alongside a little gremlin going on a quest to obtain a dragon egg.

It has over 35k words, multiple endings and comedic romance!

fields.title: King's League II
fields.description: Lead your team to victory! Recruit, train and manage fighters of different classes before entering tactical battles of wit and glory. In this sequel to an award-winning strategy simulation RPG, can you climb the King’s League?

fields.description: The final part of a great game Available 28 completely new levels. Thrice in a row is a logic game for creating chains of identical elements. The goal of the game is to put in a row from 3 identical elements, get points and go to the next level There are also bonuses.

fields.title: Untold Legends: The Warrior's Code
fields.description: Untold Legends: The Warrior's Code is a sequel to the handheld video game Untold Legends: Brotherhood of the Blade. It was released on March 2006. While very similar to the original in gameplay, Warrior's Code introduced five new character classes, improved controls, a wider array of multiplayer modes, more character customizations, and shorter load times.

fields.title: Sweet Starlight Sisters: Full Production Limited Edition
fields.description: Includes a B2 tapestry, a drama CD, 2 acrylic stands and an acrylic keyholder.

fields.title: Good Robot
fields.description: In 2031, humans could no longer survive on the Earth’s surface. PyroCorp saved the world by building massive underground cities with their army of intelligent robots. Everything was fine – until one day, when the robots lost their minds and killed all humans. As the only remaining Good Robot, you must save PyroCorp from any lawsuits that might occur.

fields.title: Spaceship Looter
fields.description: Spaceship Looter is an action roguelike game, where mercenaries of all stripes rob drifting schooner, lost transtport ships and abandoned military cruisers - all what is filled with tons of valuable loot and hidden in the deep space.

fields.title: Tantei Jinguji Saburo Series No. 09: Quito no Yoru
Gravity Ace
fields.description: Descend into dark caverns, fly and blast your way past waves of enemies, retrieve the reactor core and make your escape, all while fighting the deadly embrace of crushing gravity.

fields.title: Vader Immortal: A Star Wars VR Series
fields.description:
Step inside a galaxy far, far away with Vader Immortal: A Star Wars VR Series. You are a smuggler operating near Mustafar, the fiery world Darth Vader calls home. When you are unexpectedly pulled out of hyperspace, you find yourself uncovering an ancient mystery at the behest of the Sith Lord himself.

With the help of your droid companion, ZO-E3, you’ll navigate the dangers of the fortress, hone your lightsaber skills, and meet new characters along the way as you discover what Vader is up to.

fields.title: Such, Such Were the Joys
fields.description:
It is the year 19xx in England. You are an Indian university student who attended the boarding school Grayling Towers. You are returning to the town of Grayling after your first year at university to meet your old school friends: Cicily Thomas, Fatima Khan, and Susheela Rajaram. As the only Indian girls at Grayling Towers, the four of you quickly became close friends, but you haven't seen each other in a year. You're not sure what has changed since then, but this is your chance to find out.

fields.title: Tantei Jinguji Saburo Series No. 05: Akai Me no Tora
Lovely Fox
fields.description: Lovely Fox is a game that explores the adventures of a charming fox and her companions in the forest. This game allows players to accompany Lovely Fox on her journey as she navigates choices about lending a helping hand to fellow animals. Additionally, players can take on the responsibility of caring for Lovely Fox's beloved elderly grandfather. Embrace the spirit of kindness and contribute to the flourishing of others in this endearing game.

fields.title: Elephant Express VR
fields.description: Elephant Express - Fly around the jungle delivering mail and giving a taxi ride to your friends.Watch out for evil creatures, traps, explosives and other dangers! Fun and immersive Virtual Reality game for HTC Vive! 75+ levels in 5 specially themed episodes, hours of gameplay!

fields.title: Super Shaking Girl!!!
fields.description: Shake things up with SUPER SHAKING GIRL!!!, an exhilarating action game that'll have you shaking sodas to propel yourself through the air! Shake, fly, rinse, and repeat... The sky's the limit!

fields.title: Super Shaking Girl!!!
fields.description: Shake things up with SUPER SHAKING GIRL!!!, an exhilarating action game that'll have you shaking sodas to propel yourself through the air! Shake, fly, rinse, and repeat... The sky's the limit!

fields.title: Hunted Hunter
fields.description: Hunted hunter, is a game in which you'll have to take the form of objects on the game map, to blend into the background, in order to eliminate your opponents before they eliminate you. Everyone hunts everyone. Hide well, win games and have fun!

fields.title: Jack of Clubs
fields.description: Play golf, fight robots, and explore an 18-hole course as Jack, a pilot stranded on a recently-abandoned island resort. Discover secrets and complete challenges to earn items that improve your golf game. Unravel the mystery of the island in pursuit of your golf ball across a huge, continuous course.

fields.title: Soul In the Chamber
fields.description: Bound to the soul of an assassinated emperor and equipped with only one bullet, traverse and fight through the stylized world of Soul in the Chamber as you try to uncover the mysteries of a fallen empire and survive the collision of two dying worlds.

fields.description: Open a new chapter of epic battles! In "Lord of the Click 5" you will find a strategic deployment of troops, army upgrades and battles with powerful bosses. Evolve, use magic, and protect your kingdom from impending threats!

You start to wonder what's wrong with your life, but suddenly notice a fly in the house. Everything else is forgotten and replaced with one burning desire - kill the fly!

fields.description: Start as a small producer, produce and distribute. Fight rival gangs and become the baron of two cities.

fields.title: Elementris
fields.description: Elementris takes Tetris to the next level by giving color a meaning. Match colors, place additional pentomino shapes and explore unique gravity-game-modes and power-ups for a fresh twist on the classic block-dropping challenge.

fields.title: Intelligence: Dogs
fields.description: A puzzle game in which you want to build an image (with dogs) so that the picture was like the original image. Move the puzzle tiles wisely to correctly correct order the image pieces.

fields.title: Alchemists
fields.description: Alchemists is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 4 players. Your goal is to expel the evil spirit from cursed places by completing the 4 Element ritual. Destroy the monster alone or with your team using your tools.

fields.title: Hoppy Hop
fields.description: Join Hoppy in this classic action platformer as you collect candies, dodge enemies and jump. After all, you are a rabbit!

fields.title: Super Robot Taisen 64
fields.description: Super Robot Taisen 64 is a strategy role-playing game for the Nintendo 64. It was released only in Japan in 1999. The game can make use of the Nintendo 64's Transfer Pak with the Game Boy Color game Super Robot Taisen: Link Battler.

fields.title: Conquer Antarctica
fields.description: A turn-based combat Flash game where 2 penguins must battle other penguins floating on icebergs. Either deplete the opponents' HP or knock them off their icebergs; the last penguin standing wins! The game is the predecessor to Raft Wars, a 2007 Flash game using the same art style, objects, physics, and sound effects.

fields.title: Mystery Trackers: Fall of Iron Rock - Collector's Edition
fields.description: You’ve been sent to Iron Rock to find your long-lost colleague. But your trip quickly takes a turn for the bizarre when you find the town patrolled by the new Mayor’s robots, trapping the residents inside! Do you have what it takes to help them and escape before it’s too late?

fields.description: Jogo do Miolo-Mole is a memory game with the main characters of Fudêncio e Seus Amigos which released exclusively through the first season DVD set. It can be played on a computer if you insert the DVD into the disk drive.

Clean Up Earth is a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Clean Up Earth is the first original IP from Magic Pockets studio, based in France. Clean Up Earth will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) in Q1 2026, with the console launch dates to be confirmed following the Kickstarter campaign.

fields.title: CCCP Calls!
fields.description: CCCP CALLS! is classic communist match 3 game with beautiful anime girl! Light casual gameplay in the best traditions of the genre on the map of Europe. It's easy to learn, and hard to 3 stars!

fields.title: Super Smiling Dungeon
fields.description: Welcome to Super Smiling dungeon : the tiny and retro dungeon crawler. Train yourself to always go farther and unlock new heroes. Behind the portal, each run will be different with special rooms and some procedural generation available on each floor. Can you reach the top of the dungeon ?

fields.title: 3D Xmas Adventure: Santa's Rescue
fields.description: Armed with a magic candy cane that shoots jingles and sprinkles, you run around the North Pole gathering gifts, freeing grounded reindeer, and thawing out elves. Beware of the growling abominable snowmen and the menacing grinchy creatures!

fields.title: Gods of Sand
fields.description: Train gladiators. Manage a ludus. Fight in the arenas. Conquer the tower. Gods of Sand is a gladiator manager with intense turn-based combat, inspired by the Swords and Sandals series, in a dark and unforgiving setting.

fields.title: Pro Wrestling X
fields.description:
The genesis of Pro Wrestling X was formed in 2002. Fans of the wrestling game genre were left bitterly disappointed by glitchy, lackluster titles. Dissatisfied gamers found a collective voice online, and one of these voices – Dave Wishnowski – quit his job and set out to make his own wrestling game.

After more than 12 years years, the Pro Wrestling X team is still standing and working harder than ever. Here’s a quick rundown of what we believe, where we’ve been, and where we’re going.

fields.title: Remote Control
fields.description:
Remote Control is based on the MTV quiz show of the same name. During the game three contestants (computer or human controlled) compete by answering questions about various TV shows, movies, characters, or actors/actresses. There are two rounds of gameplay followed by a third "think real fast" round.

fields.title: Umbral Astral Dreamers
fields.description:
In the space between the tangible and the intangible exist "a bridge" that connects both realities. This bridge is called Umbral.

The Umbral is a mysterious place protected by autonomous machines made of sand and silicon called Astrals.

You take control of Aysel, a new astral on her first mission.
What will be your mission? Can you achieve it without dying in the attempt?

fields.title: Re-body
fields.description:
Re-body is a socio-experimental crawler/exploration game.

The Re-body project was created out of an interest to explore body perception, especially of queer experiences. 38 individuals were asked a simple question: how do you feel about your body? Participants were encouraged to think about their feelings in the past and present, and analyze how those feelings may have evolved or not.

fields.title: EEP Train Simulator Mission
fields.description:
Are you ready for a job in the railways industrie?
EEP TS Mission is a true innovation. For the first time in the history of EEP, the world's most successful railway simulation , you have the opportunity to take on complex tasks in the railway industrie inmidst realistic scenarios.
And there's plenty of work to do.

fields.title: Madoro-Mu
fields.description: Madoro-Mu is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Isokishi who, unlike most fangames, uses her bed to save and exits her room directly to the Nexus. Rather than having a nexus full of doors, Isokishi's nexus consists of three windows. One is nailed shut until later in the game. There is little to no sound in the game.

fields.description: In this 2D puzzle game, you have the responsibility to arrange your avian friends in a way that fits the grid. Birds Organized Neatly comes with 80 different handcrafted levels and a whole bunch of birds in all shapes and sizes.

fields.description: Brain IQTopia is a fun and educational brain training game. Challenge your mind with 10 mini-games focused on memory, math, problem-solving, and artistic skills. Test your IQ.

Bugsnax takes you on a journey to Snaktooth Island, home of the legendary half-bug half-snack creatures, Bugsnax. Invited by intrepid explorer Elizabert Megafig, you arrive to discover your host nowhere to be found, her camp in shambles, and her followers scattered across the island alone... and hungry!

It's up to you to solve the mysteries of Snaktooth Island: What happened to Lizbert? What are Bugsnax and where do they come from? But most of all, why do they taste SO GOOD?

fields.description: These days the Chestnut Lodge Asylum is abandoned and forgotten, but many years ago a terrible tragedy unfolded behind those rusty gates. Every year, patients disappeared from the asylum without a trace. Neither the nurses nor the police could find any clues. But one day, everything changed. My dreams draw me to the asylum and I yearn to return to my normal life - a life without nightmares, premonitions, and fears.... The game was released in December 2016.

fields.title: Frat Party Games: Pong Toss
fields.description: The game is played using a number of small cups placed in a bowling pin fashion at both ends of the table. Each player stands behind their group of cups and tries to toss a ping pong ball into his opponent's cups, one at a time. You can either toss the ball directly into the cup, or even bounce it off of the table. When you are successful, the ball is "removed" from the table. Your goal is to get your ball into all of your opponent's cups before he does the same to yours.

fields.description: A cute and cozy logic puzzle game about cats.

fields.description: Sago Mini Trips+ brings together four fan-favorite preschool games into one kid-friendly app – Road Trip, Boats, Planes, and Trains. Travel to far-off destinations with your Sago Mini friends and discover lots of fun and surprises along the way. With no WiFi or internet required, it’s perfect for on-the-go playtime or your next big trip.

fields.title: Mutant DNA
fields.description: A Korean fighting game released for IBM PC-DOS.

fields.title: LEGO Exo-Force: Deep Jungle
fields.description: Deep Jungle is a top-down shooter hosted on LEGO's website in 2008 to tie in with the Exo-Force wave of sets of the same name.

fields.title: World War II Armored Recon
fields.description: North Africa, 1942. Command a U.S. tank. Lead your men against the Axis powers. Learn the hard lessons of war. The odds are against you. A text-based historical novel, 700,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

fields.title: Dead Dragons
fields.description:
100 years ago, dragons were defeated by humans, and the world became peaceful.
However, one day, the main character in the story hears a rumor about the dragons which were supposed to be extinct, and comes across a mysterious young girl...

fields.description: Help The Death to undo his mess, collect souls between heaven, purgatory and hell. Run, Jump, Hide and Explore!

fields.description: A breathtaking run on rails to the heavens! Godway tests you with dynamic obstacles, platform jumping, and escalating difficulty. Fall, rise again, and push your limits to claim your place beside the god at the summit. The path to immortality begins here.

fields.title: Doll Date
fields.description: A sweetly innocent puzzle adventure game about a doll being desperate and a little naughty and disobeying her owner in the name of love.

fields.title: LEGO Bionicle: Mask of Control
fields.description: A Simple 3D Fighting game tie in to the second year of Bionicle's second generation. you play as three Toa, Tahu, Lewa and Pohatu against Skull Warriors and Umarak the Hunter on a quest for the Mask of Control. The game would later recieve an update in summer of 2016 that adds the last three toa, Gali, Onua and Kopaka, along new levels and the final battle.

fields.title: Leisure Suit Larry III: Passionate Patti in Pursuit of the Pulsating Pectoral
fields.description: Passionate Patti in Pursuit of the Pulsating Pectorals! is the third game in Al Lowe's Leisure Suit Larry series. Larry Laffer has finally found the woman of his dreams, and can happily live with her together on the beautiful tropical island... until he gets thrown out of the house by his wife. His boss, who happens to be his (now ex-) father-in-law, fires him. The Ultimate Stuntman
fields.description: Too hot to handle? Or can you take up the challenge? Equipped with a dazzling range of weapons and skills, travel through scores of different action scenes, battling against the hottest, meanest, mechanized maniacs ever dreamed up! Rescue the kidnapped scientist to halt the corrupt plans of Dr. Evil. Heaps of hardware, power-ups, bonuses, booby-trapped bombs and the baddest bosses!

fields.title: Naruto: Clash of Ninja Revolution
fields.description: Clash of Ninja Revolution covers the events of the Chunin Exams arc to the end of the Search for Tsunade arc. Clash of Ninja Revolution uses the same gameplay engine as Gekitō Ninja Taisen! EX. The game utilizes the Nunchuk accessory for the Wii Remote, for basic attacks and for special attacks that require specific movements from both items. The Classic controller and GameCube controller are also compatible with the game.

fields.description: Death Becomes You is a whodunit mystery set in a magical school. You find your best friend dead, and four suspicious students lingering around the scene. Who is the one that did it? Who is lying about their intentions on that night?

fields.title: Let's School
fields.description: This is a casual school-building game, you are entrusted by your old headmaster with the glorious task of reviving your alma mater. As the new principal, you will not only need to build a stylized school, but also train teachers, recruit students, run clubs, create your ideal personalized academy.

fields.title: UAZ Racing 4x4
fields.description: UAZ is not just another model amongst other all-terrain vehicles – it‘s a real legend of the Russian motor industry. These unique cars can go places where no man has ever even heard of the word “road”! The first Russian SUV driving simulator “UAZ RACING 4x4” is dedicated solely to this car, UAZ. Now you can show off your outstanding off-roader in the most severe durability tests and ride the really impassable roads, one of the most remarkable and famous Russian phenomena since ancient times.

fields.title: Handgun Football
fields.description: Handgun Football shatters physics: FPS meets soccer brawl. Revolvers, shotguns blast the ball into rival goals. Solo vs AI, slide from chill to hell; .LAN or global 2,3,4-teams,up to 12 players. Classic gravity or zero-g space variants. One shot flips the match.

fields.title: BobasQuest
fields.description: Welcome to the exciting world of Bobas Quest, a fun pixel art platformer where you have to make nimble jumps and complete levels using teleportation.

fields.title: A Walk Through Echoes
fields.description: Accompany an old blind man on his journey in this challenging auditory platformer game. Test your precision platforming skills, reflexes, memory, and puzzle solving in order to progress.

fields.title: Kaidi Armed With a Cat
fields.description: A game about a girl, who is armed with her cat as a gun, fighting with aussie animals. This silly game offers you a once in a life time chance to misunderstand life in Australia!

fields.title: Hungry Frog
fields.description: A game about eating bugs and dodging stingers! An entry into the Mini Jam 79: Frogs Jam.

fields.title: Vietnam War
fields.description: Open world single-player FPS. Command your squad in battle across jungles, hills and villages of Vietnam. Fight as U.S or Vietcong. Vast arsenal of weapons and 50+ vehicles

fields.title: Wasteland Rangers
fields.description: Wasteland Rangers is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you fight for survival in post-apocalyptic wastelands. Choose from four unique classes, battle across diverse locations, and prove you're the best ranger!

fields.title: Ember Sword
fields.description:
Ember Sword, a modern rewrite of the games industry business model in favor of the user, and a love letter to MMORPG (Massively Online Role Playing Game) gamers.

Ember Sword had the fast-paced combat of aRPGs, combined with the isometric view and skill-based abilities of MOBAs, set in a persistent MMORPG fantasy universe.

fields.description: Vampires Dawn: Deceit of Heretics is a mobile game and a part of the popular German Vampires Dawn series. Unlike the PC games, this game models its combat after Tactical RPGs.

fields.title: Momotaro Dentetsu Tokyo
fields.description: Momotaro Dentetsu Tokyo is a video game in the Momotaro Dentetsu series of board game-style video games genre released in 2005 by Hudson Soft for mobile phones. The game was only released in Japan.

fields.title: Chitin
fields.description:
Very short horror game made for a bug themed jam

Wanted to explore a lot of things but alas, jams are finite. I put most points on atmosphere, as my main goal for this was to try and evoke what I felt going through the rot part of Dark Souls 3 snow DLC.

fields.title: Tarthenia
fields.description: Debbie Johnson thought her days of adventure were over. But when an evil warlock intervenes on behalf of his cousin, Esmeralda, she is whisked away to the island of Tarthenia. A place beyond the realm of imagination; where beauty and danger go hand in hand. And in order to save not only her life, but her sister's as well, Debbie will have to use every ounce of ingenuity she possesses. Can she thwart the plans of a madman bent on revenge? Only time will tell!

fields.title: Dragon's Lair II: Time Warp
fields.description: Dragon's Lair II: Time Warp, the followup to Don Bluth's arcade classic Dragon's Lair, can now be enjoyed on your PC. This fully arcade authentic version includes all of the original scenes you've come to enjoy, and even the unreleased Director's Cut ending not seen in the arcades. Other bonuses include a full watch feature to sit back and enjoy Don Bluth's stunning animation.

fields.description: Become the owner of a pharmacy in Real Pharmacy Simulator! Manage the business, serve customers, and balance profit with ethics. Order medicines, organize the space, and decide how to run your business - honestly or riskily. Your decisions will determine the fate of the pharmacy!

fields.description: "The Forbidden Zone" - the ultimate fantasy world for men! Here, holy angels, charming witches, and soft beast girls are all at your disposal! The original "battle suit breaking" system, the more intense the battle, the more powerful the visual impact! 50 Live2D dynamic battle girls.

The perfect formula will be used to produce meaty rings that will be eaten by cats and dogs in our sweet homes. But disaster has struck as the experimental pet food has driven the animals into a wild frenzy; surely it is foul play! fields.title: A Lonely Cabin Trip
fields.description: You were supposed to have a relaxing cabin trip on a island all alone but after several strange encounters you had a mystery to solve, will you be able to survive a first-person psychological horror game or will you run away?

fields.title: 1Quest
fields.description: 1Quest is a roguelike, a challenging turn based RPG with high replay value

fields.title: Zerone
fields.description: Zerone is a PC-based high-quality VR game, and it is a Hyper FPS game that competes with the enemy units of the mechanic series.

fields.title: The Forest Keeper
fields.description: Survive in the merciless wastelands of a post-apocalyptic world where every day is a struggle for food, water and ammo. Fight mutants and survive as long as possible in this merciless slaughter.

fields.title: Arise: A Simple Story
fields.description: Set out on an emotional journey through the bittersweet lives of two people where memories come alive and time bends to your will. Lose yourself in moments of happiness and overcome every hardship as you relive your life’s story. A story of joy and sorrow. A simple story.

fields.title: Ninja Gaiden
fields.description:
Ninja Gaiden is an action-adventure hack and slash video game developed by Team Ninja for the Xbox video game console.
The game follows the fictional story of Ryu Hayabusa, a master ninja, in his quest to recover a stolen sword and avenge the slaughter of his clan.

fields.title: Beyond the Invisible: Evening
fields.description: At the edge of the forest lies a small Woodville town. One day the town became shrouded in mist and no one could pass through. Citizens began to disappear, one by one and fear gripped the town. Unravel the mystery of the Shadows and free the town from their dreadful fears!

fields.title: Tantei Jinguji Saburo Series No. 16: Tsubaki no Yukue
Satryn
fields.description: A chaotic, infinite twin stick shooty.

fields.title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Episode 4 - Alliance of the Golden Witch
fields.description:
Alliance of the Golden Witch is the fourth arc in Umineko no Naku Koro ni and the final arc of the original Umineko no Naku Koro ni visual novel. It introduces the character of Ange Ushiromiya and follows her quest to discover the truth of the Rokkenjima massacre.

The game was bundled with the first three episodes and was the first game to hold the full Umineko no Naku Koro ni / When They Cry 3 set of games.

fields.title: Biped 2
fields.description: Adorable robots are back to save the day! Explore an unknown planet in this puzzle action-adventure game and experiment with our unique, innovative mechanics solo or in co-op with up to 4 players!

fields.title: Cardmon
fields.description: Cardmon is a new adventure inspired in old monster-catching games. Jump in and explore the Tojo region while trying to catch all the Cardmon. Defeat every carder and become the Regional Cardmaster in this aestethic world!

fields.title: Mr. Blob's Honey-Do List
fields.description: Mr. Blob's Honey-Do List is a local coop NES inspired game. Enjoy three scenarios each with different game play styles and comic relief.

fields.title: Project MT
fields.description: Survive endless waves in this fast-paced 2D space shooter. Upgrade your ship between 20-second battles, adapt to enemy behaviors, and climb the global leaderboard. Strategic, intense, and built for replayability.

fields.title: Blade of One
fields.description: Blade of One is a methodical 2D swordfighting game with simple controls. Strike down foes in a single hit, before they do the same to you.

fields.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2 - The Mobile Game
fields.description: Live the most thrilling and magical adventure in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows - Part 2, the final and ultimate mobile game of the saga. Embody one of the three iconic characters of the saga and engage in the final battle against Lord Voldemort. Experience an astounding battle mode that includes the use of magic and an auto-lock system and confront enemies and bosses from the novel. Gain XP points to increase your level up to 20 and learn new skills, including impressive magic spells!

fields.title: Doctor Who: The Runaway
fields.description: Step inside the TARDIS with the Doctor in this beautiful, animated, interactive story from the Doctor Who team.

fields.title: Alpine: The Simulation Game
fields.description: Welcome to the beautiful world of mountains! In Alpine - The Simulation Game you can expect a varied story mode with many missions, and all this in the middle of a lovingly designed game world in the snowy Alps.

fields.title: Penalty Shoot-Out Soccer: 2010 World Champion
fields.description: Are you crazy about World Cup ? Are you a soccer enthusiast ? Now you will be able to experience a different soccer!! Penalty Shoot-Out Soccer: 2010 World Champion will bring you different experience of Soccer! Choose a country you like to play against other 31 countries and you can defeat them by penalty kick. Win the World Champion for yourself or for the country you like! No more hesitation! Simple control will greatly improve your penalty kick skills! Endless fun!!!

fields.title: Portable Farm
fields.description: A 3D idle farming game for VR that uses a portal to allow users to see and interact with the scene presented inside of it, while inside of any other VR game

fields.title: Home Is Where Chip Is
fields.description:
Feed yourself with chips.

Feel like home.

fields.title: Dissimilated Land
fields.description: Dissimilated Land is a roguelike-like action game. In this game, you will play the role of a survivor trapping in the Sedley's ruins. For some reason, you have to take an adventure in an unfamiliar environment, facing dissimilated monsters beyond imagination.

fields.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic
fields.description:
RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic is a new RCT experience, combining the best features from two of the most successful and beloved RCT games in the series’ history – RollerCoaster Tycoon and RollerCoaster Tycoon 2.

Create and run amazing parks complete with the most outrageous rides imaginable. RCT Classic includes a mixture of authentic playability, depth of gameplay and unique graphical style of Chris Sawyer’s original best-selling RollerCoaster Tycoon PC Games, now enhanced for handheld devices.

fields.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic

fields.title: War of Castle VR
fields.description: War of Castle VR is a multi-player MOBA VR game.You can fight against computer AI or other players. Unlike traditional games of this genre, it delivers a more realistic battle experience and deeper interaction. Its highly-immersive gaming environment and intense battles puts players directly onto the combat zone.

fields.title: Brewed and Battered
fields.description: Brew your own weapons from scratch and unleash them on hordes of homunculi! In this survival roguelite, every ingredient combination creates a potion that splashes, moves, and reacts in a unique way. Discover absurd synergies and rescue fellow alchemists in your quest for the Philosopher’s Stone.

fields.title: Theatre Europe
fields.description: Theatre Europe is a turn-based strategy video game developed and published by Personal Software Services. It was first released in the United Kingdom for the Commodore 64, ZX Spectrum, Amstrad CPC and Atari 8-bit home computers in 1985. It was later released in France by ERE Informatique in 1986, and was released in the United States by Datasoft later that year. fields.title: A Long Walk Home
fields.description: A short horror game jam made over three days by Jadie, Laura and Matt of Basalt Tower.

fields.title: More Lies
fields.description: Heavily inspired by Yume Nikki and Don't Hug Me I'm Scared, the content in M o RE Lie s centers specifically around playing as an antisocial adolescent who calls himself Henry, as he traverses the many diverse worlds that are laid out before him. His main objective, however, is to search for the four "Lies"; simply put, four people (including Henry himself) who have an apparent significance which cannot be explained by traditional methods. These important figures are hidden amongst the many vari

fields.title: Interstellar Plunderer
fields.description: Interstellar Plunderer is an indie arcade-style 3D roguelike space shooter game. Take control of a pirate spaceship as you fly through wormholes, do battles with hordes of oncoming enemies, fight fearsome bosses, and gain plunder to spend on new ships and upgrades. How far can you go?

fields.title: The Leviathan's Fantasy
fields.description: This is a Simulation game. You will manage your cloud city, recruit adventurers all over the world, take them for exploration, obtain resources and blueprints. Construct buildings, make equipment, produce items, so to develop your city into greatness together with your adventurers.

fields.title: Bakahaza
fields.description: BAKAHAZA is a Japanese mobile game for iOS and Android phones. The title is a portmonteau of the collaboration name "Shōnen Bakabon" × "BIOHAZARD". It is a reimagining of the 1996 Resident Evil title with the cast of Tensai Bakabon taking the place of the cast. It was released on Android in 2017.

fields.title: Burned Horizons
fields.description: A gritty, turn-based tactical sandbox set in 2002. No XP grind. No class rails. No buy-your-way skill trees. // 'They said it wasn't our war. So we made it ours.'

fields.title: Mint
fields.description: This game tells a story about an alien chasing escaped convict, to take him back to his own planet. The hero alien took form of a toothpaste to balance his body in earth's atmosphere. Mint is appointed to bring back Lugal, an escapee from its home planet.

fields.title: The Last Bloom
fields.description: Margarete receives a letter from Veronika, her kind neighbor, saying she’s ill. Concerned, Margarete decides to visit, but the journey is challenging due to her blindness. Now it’s time for you, her trusty four-legged friend, to guide her and help her reach Veronika’s house.

fields.title: Casual Sport Series: Hockey
fields.description: Grab a controller, jump on the ice and score goals to prove you're a hockey champion. Play in campaign mode against teams from around the world, alone, or with three additional players in couch mode!

fields.title: Sengoku Koihime X: Otome Kenran Sengoku Emaki Koujou-ke Souran-hen
fields.description:
Kensuke trained hard every day under the tutelage of his uncle Kazuto. One day, when he held a sword he found in the storehouse, he lost consciousness. When he came to, he found himself in a place he did not recognize. He met a girl who introduced herself as Oda Saburou Kuon Nobunaga. She held out her hand to a stunned Kensuke and asked him to become her husband and accompany her on the road to national supremacy.

They travelled across the country, racking up victories in this period of social

fields.title: Touhou DollDraft
fields.description: Touhou DollDraft is a game in which you form teams comprising "dollified" Touhou Project characters and send them into battle against each other.

fields.title: Adorable Witch 2
fields.description: Adorable Witch 2 is a casual strategy game, how to avoid the devil and guide the direction of the water drops is the key to this game.

fields.title: The Secret Monster Society: Chapter 1 - Monsters, Fires and Forbidden Forests
fields.description: A classic point-and-click comedy adventure game, set in a unique world of monsters and creatures. Embark on an epic adventure across land and sea, using time travel to stop an evil genius from destroying the world. Inspired by Saturday morning cartoons.

fields.title: Future Cowboy
fields.description: A single-player narrative game where you play as a quirky wannabe cowboy exploring the dystopian futuristic world for his own revenge.

fields.title: Forest Of Terenu
fields.description:
Enter the Forest of Terenu, a mysterious, otherworldly realm steeped in sorrow, memory, and the remnants of lost souls. In this gripping visual novel, you become Ellis, a 17-year-old girl searching for her missing brother, guided only by a flickering flame and the distant echoes of the past.

After falling asleep one night and awakening in a dreamlike yet menacing forest, Ellis finds herself trapped in a realm where light has faded and grief has taken root. The only constant is a strange glowing

fields.title: The Last Dragon Slayer
fields.description:
Go it alone... Or team up with friends!
Four Heroes arrive on the shores of Baelor, a Kingdom ravaged by the tyrannic rule of a Dragon. In order to defeat this Pagan Idol, you'll first need to scour the deep depths of mysterious dungeons, labyrinthic caves, and lush terrains.

Team up in Local Co-Op gameplay! Find secrets, collect upgrades, and power up on your journey to become the Last Dragon Slayer!

fields.title: Last Space Mission
fields.description: Last Space Mission is a 3D Wave Shooter in the space where you are the pilot of a spaceship whose planet has been conquered. Fight back and show them that you are the best star pilot in the galaxy and a cunning warrior.

fields.title: Seed of Pandora: Legend of the Gaia Tree
fields.description: Embark on an epic adventure across the continent of Pandora as you meet helpful companions along the way that will become lifelong friends. Discover the many secrets of this fully realized 16 bit style world. Beautiful anime cutscenes bring the story to life with gorgeous hand drawn art.

fields.title: My Lucky Koi
fields.description: Its`A humorous Daily story——A friendship story between a hard worker and a Koi leprechaun.——This is a Chinese short visual novel with single ending.

fields.title: Neon City Climbing Simulator
fields.description: Climb tall buildings with Neon City Climbing Simulator! Prepare for an adrenaline-filled adventure with excitement, realistic graphics, and challenging missions.

fields.description: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. fields.title: Entropy Rising
fields.description: Entropy Rising is a first-person physics-based puzzle game set in a weird world filled with mysterious flying orbs and oversized measurement devices. Control the forces of gravity, electricity, fire, water and acid. If anything goes wrong simply travel backwards through time.

fields.description: Horny Sweeper is a turn-based strategy game. The player begins the game with Kazuya and Henry alone, but afterwards more and more girls join the party. Most of the battles are against government parties, which consist of various character classes (soldiers, mages, robots, etc.). The player's party also acquires different talents over the course of the game: a healer, a shotgun-wielding character, etc. When characters attack each other, an animated sequence is displayed.

fields.title: Yuoni: Sunset Edition
fields.description: Yuoni is a first-person narrative horror game that whisks you away to a sunset-stained world to play a deadly game of hide and seek. As grade-schooler Ai, navigate authentic Japanese environments and utilise every hiding space you can find to survive the horrors ahead. And if they find you… run.

fields.title: Faith
fields.description:
Faith is a pixel horror game inspired by the era of MS-DOS, Apple II, Atari, and ZX Spectrum classics.

Forget blue-and-pink neon. The 1980s were scary. No Internet, it was hard to reach you if you weren't home, and the U.S. was engrossed in the “Satanic Scare” which fueled widespread paranoia about devil-worshiping, witchcraft, and occult practices.

fields.title: Froggy Pot
fields.description:
A super short, linear visual novel about a Froggy chilling a pot.

The pot is warm now, but it will reach a boil soon...

It will be dangerous then...so you try convincing Froggy to get out of the pot, as you both begin to chat...

About meaningless things, mindless things...

Why won't Froggy leave the pot?

fields.title: Monster Truck Arena
fields.description: Use ramps as an excuse for amazing jumps, drive your Monster Truck across cars that look like toys compared to you, do loop-the-loops... Most importantly, do all of it with style. The game's controls are designed in a way that makes pulling off mind-blowing tricks easy and effortless. 50 different missions will not only test your driving skills, but allow you to show off your inventiveness and imagination.

fields.description: An isometric co-op PvE multiplayer survival horror game. It's 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mt. Bisik. When a mysterious fog appeared, people started hearing whispers and seeing monsters. Fight, explore, solve puzzles, and figure out a way to escape... together!

fields.title: Isles of Yore
fields.description: Immerse yourself in a prehistoric ecosystem brought back from extinction. Survive and carve out your niche on islands teeming with danger and opportunity!

Through her eyes, you'll step into a unique university life brimming with warmth and local charm beside the West Lake.

fields.title: Iffermoon
fields.description:
The day the Iffermoon crashed, the world changed forever.

In Iffermoon, you will explore your new world and meet many unique characters who will be willing to join your party and help you on your quest to defeat Cosmose. Customize your party into a formidable fighting team for action based battles, engaging in physical combat as well as traditional rpg style commands.

There are also three complete games within this game, accessible through arcade machines, each with their own rewards to improv

fields.title: Crystal Comet
fields.description: Team up with your squad & take on the galaxy in this frantic twin stick space shooter "Squad em' up". Play single player with the AI or drop in / drop out local co-op!

fields.title: Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy: Complete Edition
fields.description: Based on the award-winning Brazilian animation Jorel's Brother, Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy is a point-and-click adventure about an eight-year-old boy who lives with his eccentric family in the shadow of Jorel, his handsome and popular brother. Users control Jorel’s Brother as he faces alien spaceships, authoritarian clowns, bureaucracy, driving tests, and avocado smoothies in three episodes full of humor and action.

fields.title: Unmemory
fields.description: A game you can read. A book you can play.

fields.title: No Way Out
fields.description: Escape the monotony of your daily routine and discover a path beyond this seemingly endless cycle. Embrace the thrill of the unknown, as you embark on a journey to break free from the ordinary. Will you be brave enough to take the leap, even if there seems to be No Way Out?

fields.title: Goblin Slayer
fields.description: Enter the world of Goblin Slayer, where you'll battle waves of goblins across an open map filled with levels to conquer. Collect power-up as you progress, stacking them to become incredibly powerful as you clear each wave. Take on bigger challenges and face ever-growing hordes in this fast-paced, action-packed adventure!

fields.description:

fields.description: Deprision is a psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying AAA experience. Survive human madness, amnesia's power, and navigate parallel worlds via a deadly virus. Solve your world's problem, survive, prevent more deaths, and escape before it's too late.

fields.description: The Hoff VS Hitler is a sidescrolling parody platformer that pits David Hasselhoff and his loyal car KITT up against a time traveling Adolf Hitler.

fields.description: Harder is an action rogue-like game with combat heavily inspired by the hack and slash genre. Progress through a series of enemies and bosses to reach your one true goal. Dodge, dash, parry, and slash your way through angels and demons alike in this quest to kill GOD.

fields.title: Synchrobeatings
fields.description:
A game created with Magnus Pålsson and Hannes Rahm for the GMC Jam #17.

In Synchrobeatings, you play the frustrated conductor of an ensemble. It's concert night, and your band No Sync is playing horrifically out of sync. When waving your conductor's stick around doesn't work to get the band in sync, you turn to violence!

fields.title: One Piece: Tobidase Kaizoku-dan!
fields.description: From TV Animation One Piece: Tobidase Kaizoku-dan! is a Japan-exclusive role-playing game created by Bandai for the PlayStation. It is the fourth game to be based on the One Piece manga and anime. This game's introduction uses the theme song Believe from the One Piece Anime.

fields.title: Ark: Survival Evolved
fields.description:
Ark: Survival Evolved takes on the survival genre with a unique blend of emergent multiplayer cooperation and competition. Players awake naked and starving on the beach of a mysterious island among a herd of other confused humans. On ARK, they must then hunt, harvest, craft, research technology, and build shelters to protect against scorching days, freezing nights, volatile weather systems, dangerous wildlife, and potential enemies.

Use cunning strategy and tactics to tame and ride the many din

fields.title: Der Pfad des Pinguins
fields.description:
You wake up in a snow-covered landscape and can't remember anything. You have to find out how you got to this place and survive. On your journey you meet penguins who confront you with a mysterious disease. Can you help the penguins?

This is a RPG Adventure Game!

fields.title: Trivia Crack 2
fields.description:
Sharpen your mind with Trivia Crack 2, the brain game now FULL OF TOPICS!

Test your knowledge on your favorite TV shows, movies, books, artists and more! And the brain test continues: answer fun general questions in classic categories: Art, Science, History, Entertainment, Sport and Geography. Ready to become a trivia star?

Challenge your friends and family to a trivia competition and prove how smart you are! What are you waiting for? Show off your smarts in this brain test.

fields.title: Skeleton Troubles
fields.description: Skeleton troubles - This platformer will put on your shoulders an unusual task - resurrect your skeleton hero, collecting bones and hearts in the dungeon so that he regains his strength and teach all his enemies a lesson. Jump over the spikes, dodge the cunning slugs that will shoot at you and run to victory!

fields.description: After a helicopter crash on a mysterious island, your mission is to survive and escape before the island's dark forces consume you. Explore, gather resources, and face dangerous enemies as you navigate the island's open world. Can you escape before it's too late?

fields.description: Farmers Co-op: Out of This World is a couch co-op for up to 4 players. Your people are starving back home, its up to you and three other farmers to grow as much produce as possible and send them back to your home planet.

fields.description:

fields.description: Urban Trial Tricky is a light-hearted game mixing tricks, platforming and racing. Easy gameplay, yet deep and rewarding. fields.description: Gnomophobia is an unsettling escape-horror game where gnomes stalk you through a themed forest, staying frozen only while you’re watching them. Follow the chain of visual clues hidden in notes, outsmart the gnomes’ relentless pursuit, and find the way out of the forest!

fields.description: Ghoul Panic is a comedy action-adventure game developed by Raizing and published by Namco, set in a haunted mansion.
