fields.description: Nirvana X-ROM is the companion game to the Italian SciFi film Nirvana directed by Gabriele Salvatores. fields.description: Open your own café and create a place brimming with aroma and flavor. Serve coffee, pastries, and desserts, expand your bar, decorate the interior, and serve your guests in a way that keeps them coming back for more!

Players can bombard the enemy from a distance or close the gap and dodge shells point blank - all in an immersive first person perspective.

fields.description: Life Is Strange is a third-person graphic adventure where players control a character with the ability to rewind time. fields.description: Babel: Choice is a 2D action-adventure Roguelike game which combines with the elements of RPG and shooting games. In the game, the player will play the part of Alexander, the son of the evil duke, aiming to break through the perilous and capricious Tower of Evil.

fields.description: Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

fields.description: You're trapped in hell for all eternity - at least, that's what the paperwork says. Can you escape by snooping around the private office of The Devil himself? Or will you get caught by his watchful eye?

fields.description: Bus Simulator Indonesia (aka BUSSID) will let you experience what it likes being a bus driver in Indonesia in a fun and authentic way. fields.description: Fight Night Champion is a boxing video game developed by EA Canada and published by EA Sports. It is the fifth entry in the Fight Night series and was released on March 1, 2011 for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. What truth lies behind Erina and the deal she offers to the Phantom Thieves.

Wield powerful spells fueled by your emotions to solve the mystery at the heart of Elderwood University and explore the magical world of Austerea. Every choice affects your story — and your powers!

Super Awesome RPG is an anime-themed tactical role-playing game, with a card game-style combat system designed especially for playing on the go. It offers a twist wherein actions come from what equipment your heroes wear, and executing attacks is done through a strategic battle board.

Join these unconventional heroes on a super awesome quest for riches by fighting dozens of enemy classes and bosses in an ever-expanding world! New friends join the party along the way, unlocking new playing style

fields.title: No Cortarás a tu Hermana con el Filo de Esta Espada
fields.description: The invasion is here and your only chance is to travel around the city recruiting different gangs. It is not about fighting them, violence is not going to help you this time: you will have to negotiate, know what to say and how to say it to bring them to your side and be ready once the invasion arrives.

fields.title: A Ghost Story for Christmas
fields.description: A text-based game made by Charlie Dart. It is a game about ghosts, yes, but it's also about getting to know a character for whom things are not going to end well.

fields.title: Hexagon Defense
fields.description: Welcome to the career officer, and was promoted to Admiral! This is an unusual, dynamic Tower Defense, a lot of levels. The towers have a different shooting mode, and the enemies of a different color. You will have time to repair the tower and improve them. Beware the mini-bosses! Earn medals. Good luck!

fields.title: King's Devotion
fields.description: Experience a world broken by war with one hope of redemption. Follow the tale of a general whose loyalty is put to the test when his kingdom is thrown into shambles. Friends may become enemies, and enemies may turn to friends.

fields.title: The New York Times Simulator
fields.description:
- Based on hundreds of real world news and headlines.

- Featuring the passive voice and many common framing techniques.

- A modern remake of Lucas Pope’s cult game The Republia Times.

- Free casual play. A session lasts about 10 minutes.

fields.title: Sofie: The Echoes
fields.description: Sofie: The Echoes is a third-person action-adventure game that immerses players in a story-driven experience. Explore diverse environments, solve challenging puzzles, and unravel the mysteries surrounding Sofie’s family.

fields.title: Invasion
fields.description:
The end of the world, and there's something after you. 
 
A short horror Twine about sacrifice, survival, and relative humanity.

fields.title: Synthwave Tunnel
fields.description: Take a late-night ride in Synthwave Tunnel! Race through neon-lit, rhythm-generated paths, pushing your reflexes to the limit. Speed through dynamic obstacles, synced to the beat, and conquer the ultimate challenge. Can you reach the end?

fields.title: A Week in Paradise
fields.description: A Week in Paradise is an interactive narrative mystery. Discover the unusual circumstances of your arrival to a bar called Paradise, and drink through the night with the bar's charismatic regular. Each night, unravel the threads holding back memories in your dreams.

fields.title: Slut Nurses
fields.description: Slut Nurses is an erotic game in the genre of "Arkanoid", in which you will have to break the cubes and gradually discover really beautiful and hot images.

fields.title: Self Destruct
fields.description:
Self Destruct is a hectic top-down arcade shooter made for the TIGSource PG competition. Players control a small ship that needs to survive 250 waves of enemies. The hook for this game is that all enemy waves are procedurally generated, making each gameplay sessions different.

fields.title: Pox
fields.description: Pox is a mature sci-fi interactive fiction game by Autus Developments.

fields.title: VectorMan
fields.description:
By the year 2049, Earth has been turned into a toxic waste dump. Humankind has fled into space leaving behind an army of mechanized “Orbots” to clean up the mess.
But when the Orbot leader “WarHead” goes haywire and starts a global revolt against the humans, it falls on the shoulders of the last Orbot loyal to its human masters to save the planet.

fields.title: A Land Fit For Heroes
fields.description: A Land Fit for Heroes is a profound story of three distinct characters falling into a sequence of bloodthirsty events full of gore and mystery. It is not your average story-based RPG; A Land Fit for Heroes is darker, deeper and very explicit, primarily it’s narrative is targeted towards a mature audience. fields.title: Hotel Galactic
fields.description: Hotel Galactic is a cozy management game inspired by Studio Ghibli's classic pictures. Build the tourist destination of your dreams, oversee and unite your staff to forge a quirky family, and make new friends as you explore this wholesomely nostalgic world.

fields.title: Beat.School: DJ Simulator
fields.description: Beat.School is an interactive DJ simulator that lets you gain the skills you need to succeed as a performing artist. Featuring photo-realistic versions of popular DJ gear, Beat.School let's you practice DJing right from the comfort of your own computer.

fields.title: Kirby no Omochabako: Arrange Ball
fields.description:
In Kirby's Toy Box - Arranging Balls, the player is given the goal of launching spherical Kirbys into the nine holes occupied by Mr. Frostys. The player is given a certain number of Kirbys to launch, and the game ends when he/she runs out of Kirbys to shoot. The player can choose how much power to put into each shot. Points are awarded if the player lands three Kirbys in a row—the more rows the player completes, the more points he/she will earn.

fields.title: The Alchemist & His Battle-Scarred Homunculus
fields.description:
A heartwarming tale of two broken people finding a new life together!

This heartwarming and dramatic tale follows Rakels, the young alchemist who helped create living homunculi to better the lives of mankind, only to have his partner betray him and turn their creations into tools of war. After years of exile for speaking out against their use as weapons during the war, Rakels discovers the battered form of Mel, a homunculus who was discarded by a slave trader.

fields.description: Careening is a bullet-heaven CarPG with a focus on exploration and movement. Drive across a small open world, defend yourself from the robot horde, then do it all again.

fields.description: Plop down on the couch in your comfiest pajamas, grab a big bowl of cereal, and prepare to enter "Kokoro Clover", a 2D platformer inspired by Sunday morning Japanese anime shows of the past! Transformations, cards, dancing, and robots! Let's find out what this wonderful world has in store!

fields.description: Play as a relaxed Woke DEI hire in USAID's Approvals Department, an outlandish ASMR and LOFI style US Government sim: review request, Approve or Deny, then File It before vacationing on a gifted yacht ride. fields.title: Beihai 2010
fields.description: An emotional point-and-click adventure about youth, love, and growing up. Explore Namo's memories and uncover a touching story of friendship and first love in the city of Beihai.

fields.title: This Be Mutiny
fields.description: You and your crew of swashbuckling pirates are on an epic treasure hunt! Until it inevitably devolves into mutiny. But if you can survive the backstabbings and betrayals, the treasure will be all yours!!!

fields.description: Lisa recovers from an accident for her next mission: enter the mainframe complex and connect the Megalocal Recognition system to the main control room. A simple mission.

fields.description:

fields.title: Mining My Own Business
fields.description: Enslaved you're forced underground to mine to buy your freedom. Manage stamina, weight, and torchlight as you dig for valuable ore. Sell when prices are high, upgrade your gear and shelter. Every swing of your pickaxe gets you closer to freedom. Right?

fields.title: Deep Sea Arena
fields.description: Dive into Deep Sea Arena, an intense underwater arena shooter where deadly creatures emerge from the abyss. Battle relentless waves of deep-sea horrors, dodge ambushes, and fight to stay alive. How long can you survive the depths?

fields.title: Sklime: A Difficult Climbing Adventure
fields.description: Sklime is a difficult single level twin-stick climbing game taking inspiration from Bennett Foddy's Getting Over It. The player must climb over a thousand meters out of The Depths, visiting 7 different colorful zones while playing some minigames along the way.

fields.title: Formaggio 2
fields.description: The sequel to the Scratch project Formaggio 1.

fields.title: Operation Carnage
fields.description: Operation Carnage is a top down arcade-style shoot-em-up for DOS developed by Midnight Synergy and released in 1996. It is now available as freeware.

fields.title: Otaku no Seiza: An Adventure in the Otaku Galaxy
fields.description: Otaku no Seiza tells the story of Fuyuu City, a place built in space far in the future. Aurora, a group of five attractive and powerful women, control the city. Men in the city are treated poorly compared to women, until the protagonist finds himself in the middle of the city with amnesia. Outraged, the protagonist decides to defeat Aurora and gain rights for the discriminated men of the city.

fields.title: Poly-Vinyl Pests!
fields.description: Poly-Vinyl Pests! takes place many years in the future, where humans are long gone but plastics still litter the earth. Play as two ants from rival colonies in this twin-stick shooter to both squash plastic-laden pests and to prove the superiority of your colony!

fields.title: The Abyssal Descent
fields.description:
The Abyssal Descent is a brutal 2D platformer about falling—fast, deep, and without forgiveness.
Descend through 80 handcrafted pixel-art levels, each more surreal and punishing than the last.
There are no saves, no checkpoints, and no second chances.
Learn from your mistakes, dodge deadly traps, and try to survive the abyss.
Can you reach the bottom without breaking?

fields.description: Kazeiro Surf is a PS2 visual novel, developed and published by Russel, which was released in Japan in 2009

fields.title: Ronza
fields.description: Ronza is a tense survival game where you sit at a PC, uncover dark secrets, play games and listen for dangers creeping near. Strange characters stalk you, each with their own way to counter. Stay alert, react fast, and survive the night while the computer pulls you deeper.

fields.title: VonGarland Castle: Beyond Blood
fields.description: prepare yourself for side scrolling survival horror action. Ransom VonGarland must journey to Mayhem Island and the ruins of VonGarland Castle to find her brother and uncover the truth of what Plasmadine corporation is doing on the island

fields.title: Aurora Polaris
fields.description: Aurora Polaris is a vertical shoot 'em up set in a post-pandemic future where a mysterious old engineer brings together four unlikely pilots to stop a technocratic regime known as NOX. Blending arcade action, anime-inspired visuals, and heartfelt narrative, players engage in intense boss fights, upgrade their ships, and explore handcrafted stages across a frozen Earth. Featuring local co-op, emotional cutscenes, and a unique sci-fi take on holiday mythology.

fields.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War
fields.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War is a revolutionary science fiction real-time strategy (RTS) game set in the violent, post-apocalyptic universe of the 41st Millennium. Utilizing the exceptional game design skills of Relic Entertainment, Dawn of War provides an immersive entertainment experience of epic proportions. Command hardened troops, deadly vehicles and high-tech weaponry with one goal in mind, the complete extermination of the opposition.

fields.title: League of Angels: Heaven's Fury
fields.description: League of Angels: Heaven's Fury is a revolutionary 3D online action RPG that takes place in a fantastical world loosely based on Western mythology.

fields.title: The Talos Principle: Deluxe Edition
fields.description:
The Talos Principle is a philosophical first-person puzzle game from Croteam, the creators of the Serious Sam series, and written by Tom Jubert (FTL, The Swapper) and Jonas Kyratzes (Infinite Ocean). Players are tasked with solving a series of increasingly difficult and complex puzzles woven into a metaphysical parable about intelligence and meaning in an inevitably doomed world.

This definitive version contains the original puzzler in all of its glory and the ambitious expansion The Talos Prin

fields.description: Three blues singing raisins are on a harrowing journey to escape the Raisin Factory. Battle through traditional 2D side scrolling platform puzzles to reach freedom, or face being baked in an oatmeal cookie.

fields.description:
A storm, a shipwreck, a mysterious island. Expect the unexpected on your next adventure with the Straw Hats! A new RPG from the hugely popular manga and anime series One Piece, commemorating the 25th anniversary of the series!

fields.description: Fight against a stink bug invasion with science! And cyborgs! And bravery! Or cowardice - it’s your choice, really, in this choose-your-own-adventure text game.

fields.title: Age of Empires IV
fields.description: One of the most beloved real-time strategy games returns to glory with Age of Empires IV, putting you at the center of epic historical battles that shaped the world. Featuring both familiar and innovative new ways to expand your empire in vast landscapes with stunning 4K visual fidelity, Age of Empires IV brings an evolved real-time strategy game to a new generation.

fields.title: Wildlife Park
fields.description: Here is your chance to create a giant and beautiful zoo. A park so amazing, it would be impossible to build in real life. In Wildlife Park you must build an animal park from scratch, managing it so your visitors will spend their money. You begin with just the park area, a ticket booth, and some money. From there you can buy animals, build the zoo, hire employees, and then open the gates and let the visitors come.

fields.title: Mind Teazzer
fields.description: The game is broken down into three types of puzzle games. First the player chooses from one of nine female pornstars. Each porn actress has a picture and a video clip related to her. This picture can either be made into a jigsaw puzzle, a slider puzzle, or a memory match game where when each card is matched and disappears more of the background picture is revealed. Completing any of these three puzzles unlocks a softcore pornographic clip from a Vivid Video movie.

fields.title: Fields of Glory
fields.description:
Originally released in 1993, this historical combat simulation deals with the wars of Napoleon after his return from exile in Elba in 1815.

The game is close to historical facts and therefore can be recommended to provide good information about this period of European history.

fields.description: Race through different procedurally generated terrains with several different obstacles; compete with your friends for best time and most checkpoints while collecting coins in order to unlock new cars and levels.

Players jump, run, and punch their way through visually distinct levels filled with strategically placed collectibles and exciting challenges.

fields.title: Lords of the Fallen
fields.description:
Lords of the Fallen is a challenging fantasy action RPG set in a harsh world where humanity has defeated its God. When his army starts to re-emerge from its demonic realm, led by the formidable Lords, humanity turns to an unlikely defender for help.

Lords of the Fallen offers a deep and satisfying melee combat system with weapons, armour and skills influencing speed, power and agility. Every fight is both a challenge and a meaningful victory. Powerful and spectacular magic complete the arsenal.
